subject.title: fix: generated image previews return unauthorized

question: Should authenticated callers with `operator.read` be allowed to retrieve managed generated-image bytes through `artifacts.download` when the requested session, managed record, URL, and transcript reference all match?
rationale: The branch demonstrates isolation and preserves stricter direct HTTP authorization, but repository behavior alone cannot determine whether `operator.read` is the intended permanent capability for the underlying image bytes.

options.title: Confirm RPC read access
options.body: Approve the session-bound `operator.read` RPC path, rebase the exact head, and land after required checks pass.

options.title: Require owner-level access
options.body: Restrict managed-image byte downloads to owner/admin callers and provide the Control UI with an owner-authorized retrieval flow.

options.title: Define a narrower capability
options.body: Pause this PR until a dedicated artifact-byte permission is designed and consistently applied to artifact downloads.

recommendation.title: Confirm RPC read access
recommendation.body: Approve the session-bound `operator.read` RPC path, rebase the exact head, and land after required checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent work owns the adjacent managed-media HTTP loading boundary and is the strongest available routing signal for this authorization choice.
